name: Blacksmith Together
storyline:
Blacksmith Together takes place in the small city-state of Kargutan, surrounded by four warring nations that rely on Kargutan for trade. Resources are scarce, and the city thrives through craftsmanship and an elite artisan class.

Players inherit a humble forge from an elderly master blacksmith, who has protected and taught children the craft amidst ongoing conflicts. As the master faces capture and execution for defying the authorities, it becomes the player’s responsibility to continue the forge, craft weapons and tools, trade with unique NPCs, and build a reputation in the city.

In this cooperative world, players gather resources, experiment with materials, upgrade their shop, and navigate Kargutan’s political and economic challenges to grow their blacksmithing legacy.
summary:
Blacksmith Together is a cooperative blacksmith shop management game where players run their own forge, gather resources, craft weapons and tools, trade with unique NPCs, and grow their business over time.

Players can collect materials through mining, woodcutting, fishing, hunting, and exploration, then use those resources to forge weapons, tools, armor, and custom orders for customers. Different materials affect the quality, appearance, and value of crafted items, allowing players to create unique and customizable equipment through modular blacksmithing systems.

The game features profession-based progression, skill leveling, shop upgrades, town interaction, exploration, and cooperative gameplay. Players can improve their blacksmithing abilities over time, unlock new crafting options, and work together to build a successful and respected forge in a living world.
